verdict.rationale: Postmark is a transactional email API/SaaS product, not an AI agent or agent-host platform. The evidence shows Postmark offers its own MCP server (for others to call its email tools), which is the opposite direction from this story (the product consuming/plugging in external MCP servers to use their tools). There's no agent runtime in Postmark into which MCP servers could be plugged, so this axis is a category error for this product type.
